scope_rule: B5 owns the integrated clinical water/electrolyte/acid-base judgment layer. Existing project Lectures remain Primary for 306 content. Narrow external sources are admitted only to close the previously genuine expected-compensation/mixed-disorder diagnostic gap. B3 remains the sole tubular K+/H+ mechanism owner.

source_admission.msd_scope: Expected compensation for the four simple acid-base disorders, Winter formula, AG/delta-gap and mixed-disorder inference from measured-vs-expected compensation.
source_admission.ncbi_scope: Albumin-corrected AG and delta-ratio interpretation only.

findings.historical_state: Historical B5 promised a complete expected-compensation and mixed-acid-base algorithm, but the admitted project Lectures only provided mechanism and basic pH/PaCO2/HCO3/BE recognition.
findings.adjudication: Do not model-fill. Admit a narrow external diagnostic source contract before adding formulas.
findings.resolution: MSD Manual Professional admitted for expected compensation/mixed-disorder diagnosis; NCBI/StatPearls admitted only for corrected AG/delta ratio. KP19-KP20 now contain the complete bounded diagnostic algorithm.

findings.historical_state: B5 duplicated the old universal four-grid K+-H+/urine-pH model and stored-blood RBC-rupture shortcut already rejected upstream in B3.
findings.adjudication: B3 remains the sole mechanism owner. B5 must context-gate predictions using primary disturbance, ECF volume/aldosterone, distal Na delivery/flow, NH4 excretion and renal function. Stored-blood hyperkalaemia and citrate-related alkalosis are separate mechanisms.
findings.resolution: KP15 rewritten as B3 Recall/Apply. Universal urine-pH grid removed from learner-canonical text. Stored blood uses storage lesion/K+ accumulation in supernatant for K load and citrate metabolism for a separate alkali load.

resolution.metabolic_alkalosis: Expected PaCO2 rises about 0.6-0.75 mmHg per 1 mmol/L HCO3- rise from the 24/40 anchor; simple compensation generally does not drive PaCO2 above about 55 mmHg.
resolution.respiratory_acidosis: For each +10 mmHg PaCO2, HCO3- rises about 1-2 mmol/L acutely and 3-4 mmol/L chronically.
resolution.respiratory_alkalosis: For each -10 mmHg PaCO2, HCO3- falls about 1-2 mmol/L acutely and 4-5 mmol/L chronically.
resolution.mixed_rule: Measured compensation outside expected range implies another primary process or an incorrect acute/chronic assumption; do not label it over/under-compensation.

resolution.albumin_correction: Corrected AG = measured AG + 2.5 x (4.0 - albumin[g/dL]) when albumin is substantially low.
resolution.delta_interpretation: <1 concurrent NAGMA direction; 1-2 uncomplicated HAGMA direction; >2 concurrent metabolic alkalosis or pre-existing high-HCO3 direction.
resolution.guard: Local laboratory reference ranges and clinical context remain required; delta metrics are diagnostic aids, not standalone disease labels.

findings.resolution: Project Lectures keep ownership of water/Na/K/Ca, supplementation/treatment Precision and renal acid-handling mechanisms. External source authority is diagnosis-only for the admitted gap. First-pass questions remain Lecture-attached, not external-source generated.

whole_a3_effect: B5 was the final system-below Block-level K blocker. All 14 numbered A3 Blocks can now be accepted at Block-level K, but A3 System-level K/S/L/P/R/E/U and learner readiness are still NOT promoted and require separate later acceptance work.
